title: scripts/status.py keeps only what testiface.py and adapter-unittest.py use; the config schema drops the keys only its removed code read
objective: scripts/status.py and A's config schema hold only what some code still reads.
outline: scripts/status.py: rewrite to the B1 set; copy each kept def and assignment unchanged (B3), keep the comments directly above kept constants, drop the imports only removed code used (argparse, hashlib, io, json, shlex, subprocess, datetime). The four kept functions are used as: adapter-unittest.py normalized_failure_message, suspect_row, parse_environment_suspects, reports_dir, ENGINE, DEFAULT_ENV_FAIL_FAST_THRESHOLD, ENV_SUSPECT_RC, SUSPECT_KEYS, event; testiface.py reports_dir, suspect_row, SUSPECT_KEYS, ENV_SUSPECT_RC, event (grep, 2026-11-28; nothing in devloop/, bin/actl, scripts/*.sh, templates/ or any test imports status or runs its command line). The removed code is the old gate's status-file CLI (start, phase, done, failures, suspects, rundir, regression-red, show) and its helpers; it read the config keys flaky_threshold, flaky_auto_ticket, routing, regression (.rerun_cmd), regression_auto_ticket and unit_cmd, which nothing else reads (git grep of `.get("<key>")` and `["<key>"]` over *.py, *.sh and bin/, 2026-11-28); reports_dir and environment_fail_fast_threshold stay (live readers). scripts/project_config.py: remove the six SCHEMA rows (`routing` near the top, `flaky_threshold`, `flaky_auto_ticket` in the flaky block, `unit_cmd`, `regression`, `regression_auto_ticket` under `# read at base, not in the design table`; that comment stays for gate and guard_main_paths) and the three names from the `## Schema` docstring paragraph. No config_version bump and no migration: a bump would make every command of every version-2 project refuse until `actl migrate`; unknown keys are silent in `check` and a warning in doctor / migrate by the existing #185 rule, so a project config that still holds a key keeps working and is told it is possibly retired. tests/control_harness.py: B7 line only. scripts/adapter-unittest.py: only the sentence of B8, inside the paragraph that begins `**One runner in A**` (docstring lines 9-14); leave lines 15 onward untouched - ticket #166 (g20) edits the exit-code line and the result.json paragraph of the same docstring and the STATUSES / RANK lines. Do not touch scripts/testiface.py (ticket #147 edits it), CODE-MAP.md (regenerated at landing), board/config.json (its map row for scripts/status.py stays). Out of scope: scripts/event.py helpers that only the removed code called; other SCHEMA keys nothing reads today (a rough grep on 2026-11-28 found no reader outside project_config.py for e.g. flake_auto_single_runs, flake_auto_group_runs, batch_fix, verify_case, guard_main_paths - inferred, not checked per key); the .gitignore comment that names status.py; the design documents under docs/design.
test_plan: Verifier writes B2 and B4-B6; each is red on today's code. B2 goes in tests/test_adapter_unittest.py as one class `T<id>Acceptance(unittest.TestCase)` placed between `class Select(unittest.TestCase)` and `class Fixture(unittest.TestCase)` (right before `class Fixture`; ticket #166 uses the gaps after RunWritesSchemaOne and after EnvironmentSuspect). It reads os.path.join(ROOT, "scripts", <file>) with ROOT from control_harness (the tree under test), uses only ast and re, no subprocess; three methods: functions and classes, assigned names, no top-level if; the precondition (B1's four function names are defined) is asserted first in the functions method. Expected values come from this ticket (the rule and B1's names), never from status.py. B4-B6 go in tests/test_project_config.py as one class `T<id>Acceptance(ConfigSandbox)` placed between `class T5Acceptance(ConfigSandbox)` and `class T125RepairKeys(ConfigSandbox)`: B4 imports project_config the way `test_a1_the_schema_defaults_are_3_and_1` does; B5 and B6 use `self.edit_conf(**values)` (it pops a key only for None, so false, 0 and [] are written) and `self.actl("doctor")` / `self.actl("check")`; B5 counts lines per key with the quoted `key '<key>'` text, so `regression` never matches the `regression_auto_ticket` line. The implementer owns B1, B3 (a one-off script comparing ast.get_source_segment per kept name between `git show <base>:scripts/status.py` and the branch; report the result in the hand-in, it is not a permanent case), B7, B8 (grep checks) and B9, running `python3 "$AC_HOME/devloop/run_tests.py" test_adapter_unittest test_adapter_cases test_project_config test_project_config_cases test_no_project_names` plus the verifier's cases. Mutations that must turn red: append `def parse_failures(log_path):\n    return []` to status.py -> B2 red; put `("routing", "object", NO_DEFAULT),` back into SCHEMA -> B4, B5 and B6 red (inferred from today's behaviour, which these cases are measured red against; not run as mutations by the opener).
notes: Group: new-g1, with the snapshot-measurement ticket of this hand-in: the request asks for plan group 6 as one group; this ticket edits scripts/adapter-unittest.py and tests/test_adapter_unittest.py, which #166 (g20) also edits, at spots kept apart (see outline and test_plan), and it does not touch scripts/testiface.py, which #147 edits. 'Nothing else changes behaviour': the only behaviour changes are B5 and B6 (A no longer knows the six keys). Code and tests must not name the project whose pool or config shape is meant (tests/test_no_project_names.py forbids its name in every non-.md file). Words the merge stop matches in any added line, docstrings and tests included: the Python call that sends a process a signal through the os module, the group-signal function, the pattern-match process killer, and the shell command for signals followed by a space and a dash; the code you keep contains none of them and nothing you add needs them. Do not edit the decisions file or the vision file under docs/.
acceptance: B1 scripts/status.py defines at module level exactly these functions: normalized_failure_message, suspect_row, reports_dir, parse_environment_suspects; exactly these assigned names: DEFAULT_REPORTS, DEFAULT_ENV_FAIL_FAST_THRESHOLD, ENV_SUSPECT_RC, ENGINE, SUSPECT_PREFIX, SUSPECT_ENGINE, SUSPECT_KEYS; it imports os, re and sys, and `event` as today (sys.path.insert of its own directory, then `import event`), so `status.event` stays the module both callers use. It has no command line: no main, no argparse, no top-level `if __name__ == "__main__":` block.

B2 Guard over scripts/status.py read with ast (top level only): every function or class it defines is named as `status.<name>` (regex `(?<![\w.])status\.([A-Za-z_]\w*)`) in the text of scripts/testiface.py or scripts/adapter-unittest.py; every name it assigns (Assign / AnnAssign targets that are plain names) is either named that way or read as an ast.Name inside the body of one of those functions; it has no top-level `if` statement; and the four function names of B1 are among the defined names. Today 39 of 43 functions, 13 of 20 assigned names and 1 top-level if break the rule (measured 2026-11-28 on 4797416 with exactly this rule).
B3 The source of each kept def and each kept assignment is byte-identical to main's (ast.get_source_segment of the node on main and on the branch, compared per name).

B4 project_config.SCHEMA (scripts/project_config.py) has no row whose key equals, or starts with `<key>.` for, any of: flaky_threshold, flaky_auto_ticket, routing, unit_cmd, regression, regression_auto_ticket. CURRENT_VERSION stays 2 and MIGRATIONS is unchanged.

B5 `actl doctor` in a ConfigSandbox whose config gets flaky_threshold=3, flaky_auto_ticket=false, routing={"implement": "opus"}, unit_cmd="make test", regression={"rerun_cmd": "make test"}, regression_auto_ticket=false exits 0 and prints, for each of the six keys, exactly one stdout line that contains both `key '<key>'` (with the single quotes) and `possibly retired`. Today it prints no such line (the keys are known).

B6 `actl check` in a ConfigSandbox whose config gets routing="opus", unit_cmd=5, flaky_threshold="three", flaky_auto_ticket="no", regression=[], regression_auto_ticket=1 exits 0 and its stderr contains none of `'routing'`, `'unit_cmd'`, `'flaky_threshold'`, `'flaky_auto_ticket'`, `'regression'`, `'regression_auto_ticket'` (each with its single quotes). Today it exits 2 with one type error per key.

B7 Old fixture changed in place: tests/control_harness.py DEFAULT_CONFIG loses its `"routing": {"implement": "opus"},` line (only the removed status.py code read it). Measured 2026-11-28 on a scratch copy of 4797416: with the six SCHEMA rows removed and that line kept, test_project_config.A3Doctor.test_a3_clean_version_2_has_no_rows turns red (its assertNotIn("retired") meets the new 'possibly retired' row); with the line removed too, test_project_config, test_project_config_cases and test_no_project_names are green.

B8 Docs follow the code: status.py's module docstring says what the module now is (the environment_suspect row shape of D-019, the declared-row parser, the failure-message shape and reports_dir, shared by scripts/testiface.py and scripts/adapter-unittest.py) and keeps the two sections that explain kept names (the one headed `## 環境壞了要當場停(rc=86)` and the one headed `## 環境可疑的兩條來源收成同一格`), minus sentences that describe only removed code; the usage block and the other sections go. project_config.py's `## Schema` paragraph no longer names unit_cmd, regression or regression_auto_ticket. In scripts/adapter-unittest.py `grep -c 'status.py done'` is 0: the sentence that ends `stays in \`status.py\`, which \`status.py done\` needs even in a copy that has no adapter next to it.` ends `stays in \`status.py\`, which \`scripts/testiface.py\` imports too.`

B9 test_adapter_unittest, test_adapter_cases, test_project_config, test_project_config_cases and test_no_project_names are green on the branch (opener's measurement: green in 43 s on a scratch copy with status.py stripped to the B1 set and the B7 fixture change).
token_basis: Worker: read scripts/status.py (1211 lines, 57 KB) once, the status.* uses in the two callers, scripts/project_config.py (446 lines), one line of tests/control_harness.py; write a ~110-line status.py, delete six SCHEMA rows, three docstring edits; one 43 s test run plus the verifier's cases. Verifier: two classes of about 40 lines each (ast guard; config sandbox with doctor and check), red check. Calibrated on landed simple tickets with a verifier (#154, #156, #159, #160: 1.1M-2.7M tokens including cache reads).
vision: VISION, 這份文件是什麼: every mechanism, field and script must map to the vision or be justified with numbers, else downgraded or deleted; and the rule 'add one gate, remove one'. status.py goes from 1211 lines (57 KB, roughly 15k tokens for any agent or code-map reader that opens it) to about 110, and six schema keys nothing reads leave A. Metric: 每張落地票的 token 與時間 (down), by roughly 12k tokens for each agent that reads status.py while working on the test interface or adapter.
removes: The 39 unused functions and 13 unused constants of scripts/status.py (its whole command line: start, phase, done, failures, suspects, rundir, regression-red, show) and the six config keys only they read (flaky_threshold, flaky_auto_ticket, routing, unit_cmd, regression, regression_auto_ticket) from A's config schema.
request:
Phase one, group 6 of the improvement plan: measure first, and subtraction (D-100, D-102). Source: external audit
P2-2 and P2-5. One group, two tickets.

6.1 Measure the cost of `Pool.snapshot()` on a pool the size of tabby_pool's (about 550 tickets; build a synthetic
pool of that size in the test). Record the measured time in the ticket's result. Only if it is slow (over 0.5 s on
this machine per call) add a cache keyed by the pool repo's local HEAD sha, invalidated by any write through Pool;
otherwise add no cache and leave a short note in devloop/README.md with the measured number.

6.2 Remove dead code from scripts/status.py: keep only the functions still used by `testiface.py` and
`adapter-unittest.py` (find the real callers with grep), and remove the config keys only that dead code read.
Nothing else changes behavior.

vision: the snapshot path is measured before anyone optimizes it, and status.py holds only code something uses.
removes: the unused functions of scripts/status.py and the config keys only they read.
